## Problem or evidence gap

Describe the reproducibility, security, developer-experience, or technical-evidence gap that this improvement would address.

## Proposed approach

Describe a client-safe, testable approach. Do not propose customer data, production configuration, or unverified business claims.

## Verification

State how a reviewer could verify that the improvement works.
